title: Consolidate unique safe changes from all repository branches into protected main
scope: Inventory, classify and integrate unique code while preserving main and security boundaries

criteria.given: Repository has multiple active and historical branches
criteria.then: Every branch is classified and ancestry is recorded

criteria.given: A branch has unique changes absent from main
criteria.then: Unique changes are reconciled without loss or duplicate migrations and security boundaries remain fail-closed

criteria.given: Integration branch CI and security review are complete
criteria.then: Server-side ruleset requires successful checks and independent approval

criteria.given: Every unique branch change is accepted or formally excluded
criteria.then: All decisions and traces are reproducible on exact main SHA
